parts.0.title: Hören — Listening
parts.0.instructions: Listen to each item and choose the right answer. In the real exam each item is played twice; here you can listen as often as you like, but try to listen at most twice.
parts.0.questions.0.why: Durchsage: „von Gleis sieben“. fünf is only said at the start of the announcement.
parts.1.title: Lesen — Reading
parts.1.instructions: Read each short text and choose the right answer. Richtig = correct, Falsch = wrong.
parts.1.questions.2.why: 2-Zimmer-Wohnung = two rooms (Küche and Bad are not counted).
parts.1.questions.5.why: „manchmal auch am Wochenende“ — so „nie“ is wrong.
writing.0.taskBn: You are joining a gym (Fitnessstudio). Fill in the form with your own details (write on paper or in your head).
writing.0.checklist.0: I wrote Name and Vorname in the right boxes (surname = Name)
writing.0.checklist.1: I wrote the date as day.month.year
writing.0.checklist.2: Address: street + number, then postcode + city
writing.0.checklist.3: I wrote my Hobby in one word
writing.1.taskBn: Write 2–3 sentences to your friend Tom, inviting him to your birthday party on Saturday at 6 pm.
writing.1.checklist.1: I made the invitation (ich lade dich … ein)
writing.1.checklist.2: I wrote the day and time (Samstag, 18 Uhr)
writing.1.checklist.3: There is a question or request (Kommst du?)
writing.1.checklist.4: I ended with „Viele Grüße“ and my name
writing.1.checklist.5: The verb is in 2nd position (Die Party ist …)
speaking.0.instructions: Look at each word and say a full sentence aloud. Then listen to the model and compare.
speaking.0.prompts.1.bn: Which country do you come from?
speaking.1.instructions: Make a question from the word on the card. Someone else (or you yourself) answers.
speaking.2.instructions: Make a polite request; when you hear a request, respond (Ja, gern! / Tut mir leid …).
speaking.2.prompts.1.bn: Ask someone to close the window
speaking.2.prompts.3.bn: Ask someone to say it again
